name: Mushroom Sauce
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: small button mushrooms
ingredients.originalText: a pint of small button mushrooms

ingredients.name: veal gravy or milk or cream
ingredients.originalText: veal gravy or milk or cream

ingredients.name: little butter rolled in flour
ingredients.originalText: a little butter rolled in flour

instructions.text: Wash a pint of small button mushrooms
Remove the stems and outside skins
Stew them slowly in veal gravy or milk or cream, adding an onion, and seasoning with pepper, salt and a little butter rolled in flour
Heighten their flavor by salting a few the night before, to extract the juice
If there is a poisonous one among them, the onion in the sauce will turn black and the whole should be thrown away

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Wash a pint of small button mushrooms
2. Remove the stems and outside skins
3. Stew them slowly in veal gravy or milk or cream, adding an onion, and seasoning with pepper, salt and a little butter rolled in flour
4. Heighten their flavor by salting a few the night before, to extract the juice
5. If there is a poisonous one among them, the onion in the sauce will turn black and the whole should be thrown away
